changelog.title: Performance Overhaul & New Settings
changelog.description: Significant performance improvements across the dashboard and newly updated centralized settings module.

items: Complete dashboard layout redesign with a unified system
Animated toggles and fully resolved states
Dedicated Changelog page to track updates
Card hover states and elevation design
Toggle switches are now correctly anchored in both disabled and checked states
Theme colors are far more consistent
Resolved visual shifting bugs for off-state toggle switches
Fixed padding in `.badge` component to ensure even scaling
Resolved a few visual z-index conflicts on the header overlay

changelog.title: Minor Adjustments to Animations
changelog.description: Small animation fixes for the sidebar loading.

items: Optimized CSS size and reduced duplications
Sidebar transition lag fixed by applying uniform timing
